rationale: All three protected limitations held at the same strength. The common-method caveat remains: “self-reported, so shared response tendencies may have inflated their association.” The temporal caveat remains: “does not establish temporal ordering and cannot rule out that exhaustion disrupts routines,” preserving reverse causation. The sampling caveat remains: the “volunteer sample drawn from metropolitan counseling networks may limit generalization” to the same populations specified originally. No limitation became a strength or was deleted. Reordering the Ferreira (2018) contextual-variability rationale into the final sentence and tightening “cannot rule out the possibility that” to “cannot rule out that” are authorized condensation without substantive change.
